note: Recovery run on devnet against the live table (37 accounts).

requestUndelegation.result: the validator undelegated the account about five seconds later and removed the request; setup-table then delegated it again

rollbackUndelegation.result: reaches the Delegation program, which refuses it: no undelegation request exists ("Invalid account owner for undelegation request")

teardown.order: the table last; every account came back to the base layer and was delegated again by pnpm setup-table --arm
teardown.finding: an intent that is too big for one base-layer transaction is refused by the TEE with custom error 0xa0000002 and nothing is sent. Passed: 8 small accounts, 4 leak vaults, 6 call vaults, the two markets, any single account (the 7 KB X-ray included). Refused: 6 leak vaults, the first group of 8 (tape to X-ray), 4 leak vaults with 4 call vaults. pnpm teardown therefore starts with groups of about 1.5 KB and halves a refused group.

afterwards: the bots finished the round, resealed and seeded the next one on their own
